approach: Original PS4 x86-64 game code running directly on Windows and Linux through replacement PS4 system libraries and a Vulkan renderer derived from shadPS4
notes: Public native Windows release with an experimental Linux/Steam Deck AppImage. Supports CUSA00062 1.00 and 1.06 Europe and CUSA04430 1.00 Asia/KR. Includes the TRG launcher and package installer, online co-op for 2 to 4 players with Friends, Friend Codes, invitations, public Lobby, direct P2P and automatic relay fallback, local co-op for up to 4 players on CUSA00062 1.06, render resolutions up to 4K, experimental True Ultrawide, high-refresh presentation modes, FSR 1 and RCAS, SMAA, Xbox controller prompts, local trophies, Bug Report, Skip Intro, Exit Game, a self-updater and portable user data. No game files are included.
